digest.component_or_area: ticket state model and event schema
propositions: bridge_project and repos fields must be added to ticket state schema and projected by reducer on both CREATE and EDIT events
Create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos must be supported across all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with identical resulting state
bridge_project is tri-state (absent for legacy, explicit empty string for never-sync, or key for sync) and distinguishable after replay
bridge_project is promote-only and editable post-create only if ticket is unbound; attempting to change it on a bound ticket must fail with non-zero exit and no state change
repos field is freely editable and never reaches the tracker; inbound defaulting from project mapping is deferred to separate child ticket
Pre-feature tickets replayed after this change must produce identical state apart from the two new keys
